---
title: "Provenance"
---

Where every input came from and how every result was produced.

## Manifest

`provenance.yml` holds the machine-readable record: project, template
version, sources and the protocol freeze. `just freeze-protocol` hashes the
files listed under `protocol.files`, records the time and the commit, and
refuses to run twice. After the freeze, `just check` fails if a frozen file
changes; record changes as deviations in `protocol.qmd` instead.

## Data sources

One entry per file or dataset in `data/external/`.

| Dataset | Source | Version or access date | Licence | Checksum |
| ------- | ------ | ---------------------- | ------- | -------- |

## Software environment

The Python environment is pinned by `uv.lock`, and the Python version by
`.python-version`. Record any tool not managed by uv here, with its version.

## Results

For each table and figure in `results/`, record the code that produces it
and the inputs it reads.

| Output | Produced by | Inputs |
| ------ | ----------- | ------ |
